_comment: The single source of truth for what this app does with data. Three things are generated from it and must never drift apart: ios/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, store/app_privacy_details.json, and the published privacy policy page. Change this file, re-run the generators, do not hand-edit the outputs.
storesOnDevice: Which of the daily ten you answered and whether each was right, so the app can show your score, your streak and your calendar.
Your settings: whether onboarding is done, whether the daily reminder is on and what time it is set to, and your last practice category and difficulty.

network.why: Practice rounds are fetched live, because they are not part of the offline pack.
network.sends: The category and difficulty you picked. No identifier, no account, nothing about you.

requiredReasonAPIs.why: @AppStorage, used only for this app's own settings.

purchases.name: Quizday Pro
purchases.freeTier: The daily ten is free forever, with no ads and nothing that runs out. Pro adds practice, not access.

notifications.why: One optional daily reminder, scheduled on your device. It is off until you turn it on, and no reminder is ever sent from a server.

attribution: Practice questions come from the Open Trivia Database, used under CC BY-SA 4.0. The 300 questions in the daily pack are original and written for this app.
